svg.text: STAGE 521 · TOPIC 161 · P1035–P1036 🎉 · SVG 165 🎉 · 163rd FAQ · 🎉 HISTORIC 165th SVG & 1,045th GUARDRAIL DUAL MILESTONE!
SIP RFC 6141 / RFC 3261 re-INVITE Intermediate SDP Commit Preservation & Contact Rollback Guard
⛔ Vulnerable RFC 3261 Full Rollback (Video Decline Kills Voice)
1. Naive Full Rollback Wipes Committed PRACK / UPDATE Audio
re-INVITE -> 183/PRACK commits Audio=40002 -> 488 Decline Video
• Legacy gateway rolls Audio back to 40000 while peer stays on 40002
• Declining camera upgrade mutes the active AI voice call!
2. Unreverted Contact Remote Target on Failed re-INVITE
re-INVITE (Contact_v2) fails with 488/491 -> Contact_v2 kept!
• Violates RFC 6141 §4.2 target-refresh rollback mandate
• Subsequent BYE and UPDATE requests route into a blackhole
3. 180s Hung re-INVITE Prompt & 8x Nested UPDATE Churn
Caller ignores video prompt -> Dialog locked for 180 seconds
• Blocks all subsequent hold/transfer signaling during hang window
• Unbounded nested UPDATE loops exhaust B2BUA state machines
✅ Deterministic RFC 6141 Guardrails (P1035 + P1036 🎉)
P1035 (1,044th Guardrail): Intermediate SDP Commit Lock & [1, 3] Cap
action: "preserve_committed_update_prack_sdp_and_cap_nested_exchanges"
• Preserves committed PRACK / UPDATE SDP checkpoints on 4xx–6xx
• clampedDroppedActiveAudioStreamsOnReinviteReject = 0
• clampedMaxNestedOfferAnswerExchangesPerReinvite in [1, 3]
Policy: P1035-SIP-RFC6141-REINVITE-INTERMEDIATE-OFFER-ANSWER-COMMIT-PRESERVATION-GUARD
P1036 🎉 (165th SVG & 1,045th Guardrail!): Contact Rollback & [5, 32]s
action: "rollback_failed_reinvite_contact_target_and_clamp_timeout_sec"
• Two-phase Contact staging; atomic rollback on failed re-INVITE
• clampedDesyncedRemoteTargetDialogs = 0 (zero routing blackholes)
• clampedReinviteTransactionTimeoutSec in [5, 32] seconds
Policy: P1036-SIP-RFC6141-FAILED-REINVITE-TARGET-REFRESH-CONTACT-ROLLBACK-GUARD
